title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults, quantization profiles, unit-econ tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Reduce per-token unit economics for hosted and dedicated workloads by auto-tuning sensible batching and KV-caching defaults, providing quantization profile recommendations, and exposing unit-econ tooling for operators. This PR implements an autotune pipeline that derives per-model default batch_size and cache_window heuristics from request telemetry, introduces a set of curated quantization profiles for commonly used open models, and ships a lightweight unit-economics CLI + backend endpoints to estimate cost/latency tradeoffs. Scope: runtime heuristics, controller autoscale defaults, model registry metadata, UI + CLI tooling, and docs. Changes include: 1) autotune service that consumes p99 latency/throughput slices and suggests batch_size/cache_window; 2) model registry fields for quant_profiles and preferred_defaults; 3) runtime adaptation to prefer cached prefixes (respecting privacy flags); 4) unit-econ API and CLI that ingest sample workloads and output estimated cost/token and recommended config; 5) dashboard snippets in Console and docs updates. Checklist: [x] design doc updated (ENG-10234 link) [x] e2e tests for autotune pipeline [x] unit tests for quant profile selection [x] backwards-compatible runtime flags [x] docs/console snippets added [x] perf benchmark included. Testing & Observability: synthetic workload benchmarks included in perf-canary; added metrics: autotune.suggestions.count, quant.profile.apply.count, uecon.estimate.latency_ms. Rollout: feature gated behind cost_opt_autotune flag, staged on dedicated then rolled to hosted. Risks & mitigations: invalid autotune suggestions can be rolled back by flag; manual overrides in Console; quant profiles are advisory and require opt-in for private deployments. Follow-ups: expand quant profiles to more architectures, integrate with Optimize recommendations engine, and add per-customer historical trend analysis.

release_notes: Adds autotune pipeline for batching/caching defaults, introduces curated quantization profiles in the model registry, and ships a unit-economics CLI and API to estimate cost/latency tradeoffs. Feature gated; rollouts controlled via cost_opt_autotune flag.
high_level_perf_results: p95 latency: +3% (120ms -> 123ms) under peak but within SLOs
cost/token estimate: -12% on average for chat workloads after applying suggestions
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes are behind a feature flag and include manual override paths. Main risk is incorrect autotune suggestions for niche workloads; mitigated with stability windows, daily rollups, and operator review. Quant profiles are advisory; no forced model conversion.
